verdict.rationale: Lovable's enterprise documentation lists "regional code hosting" among its enterprise features. That is a first-party region/residency capability, but it is a single thin mention, apparently enterprise-only, and covers code rather than clearly all project data. missing for 10: documented region selection for app/Cloud database and storage data, details on available regions and how to choose them, availability on non-enterprise plans, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
